name: Yueyang Xingchang Petro-Chemical Co., Ltd.
summary: Yueyang Xingchang Petro-Chemical Co., Ltd. engages in the production and sale of chemical products in China. It offers methyl tert-butyl ether, liquefied petroleum gas, propylene, industrial isooctane, o-cresol, calcined petroleum coke, specialty polypropylene, synthetic materials, and petroleum and plastic products. The company also provides energy and chemical, new chemical materials, refined oil, and other products. In addition, it is involved in research and development of special catalyst technologies, catalyst application development, and the development of new polyolefin products. Yueyang Xingchang Petro-Chemical Co., Ltd. was founded in 1989 and is headquartered in Yueyang, China.
